span.p:
Deciding
between M2 and M3
— switching conditions
(Tier M3) —
Complementarity:
M3 is never used alone; it must be coupled to a mass balance (M1+M3, M2+M3). M0+M3 is nonsensical (M0 = total transfer). M2 is not less robust than M3: they complement each other (partitioning & diffusivity).

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Starting point:
estimate migration potential (PR) for a material/food system, with explicit mass balance (sources, volumes, K, θ).

span.p:
M3
or experimental validation
(ionized, highly hydrated, atypical)

span.p:
Assembly
with a barrier layer
(glassy polymer, thick layer) or low-diffusivity substances?

KF/j highly uncertain
and decision is tight,
with a chance that kinetic weighting v̄i*(t) (thus PRTi) improves the outcome?
